// About the Album

From Beyond is the latest full-length from BCVHS and the most ambitious to date. A concept album set on Halloween Night, 1986, it follows DJ Nasty Nick Nash as he unknowingly narrates an alien invasion in real time on fictional heavy metal station 96.6 The Lazer. Produced, written, and recorded by BCVHS and mastered by Tanner Cundy at Sleepy Owl Soundlab, the record arrives October 2, 2026 on digital and limited cassette.

The album is accompanied by From Beyond: Arcade Edition, a companion arcade shmup developed by Turbo Intercept Interactive in which players battle BPM-synced alien waves set to the album's soundtrack. The game launches simultaneously on Steam.
